title: Zero Fat Croatian Beef Dumplings
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring lean minced beef, these dumplings are malty, crumbly, and perfect for a midnight craving. They are also shojin-friendly, making them suitable for a variety of diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the lean minced beef, whole wheat flour, oat flour, malt powder, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg whites and water until frothy.
Add the egg mixture to the beef mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F.
